system.description:
Make a melee taijutsu attack as if you are trying to slam the target through the ground dealing 6d6 bludgeoning damage on a hit and forcing them to make a strength saving throw, being forcefully pushed 10-feet- into the ground. Creating a crater and being Dazed on a failed save.

Finisher: You instead deal [Unarmed Damage] + 6d6 damage and if the affected creature fails their saving throw by 5 or more, they are instead Stunned until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6
